newsitem.title: USA: Laboratory Specialists sees Q2 gains.
newsitem.headline: Laboratory Specialists sees Q2 gains.

text.p: Laboratory Specialists of America Inc, which operates a nationally certified laboratory that provides employee testing for drugs of abuse to corporate and institutional clients, said Tuesday it expects a recent acquisition to boost second quarter results.

Earlier today, the company reported 1997 first quarter earnings rose to $234,003 or $0.07 a share from $202,246 or $0.06 for the same period in 1996. Revenues increased to $2.6 million from $1.9 million in the 1996 first quarter.
First quarter results include one month of increased revenues from a recent acquisition of the forensic testing operations of Pathology Laboratories Ltd.
"We look forward to seeing the full impact of increased revenues and earnings from this acquisition in the second quarter," said John Simonelli, chairman and chief executive, in a statement.
